title: G's TV
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Watch video pictures while parked. A home screen of sources: Spelunkr (spelunkr.tv's channels of programmes on the Internet Archive, no DRM, no sign-in) with CH up / CH down, swipe up / down to change channel, a channel banner, a 2-hour guide with category filters and a fullscreen picture; and your own sources: direct links to one MP4 file (H.264 video) each, sent from your phone with a QR code or a 6-digit code (end-to-end encrypted), checked by the car before they are saved, resumed where you left off. Instant resume: back in P the picture continues where it stopped (the last picture stays dimmed while driving), and opening the app goes back to what you watched; for Spelunkr choose resume where I stopped or jump to what's on now. Hold a source to rename it, send a new link or remove it. Web pages and players are refused. Decoded in the app (WebAssembly H.264). Video only, no sound yet. Parked only: the picture shows only while the speed is known and at most 3 km/h and the selector is in P, otherwise 'Video available when parked'. HUD and Cluster buttons on the picture's controls: one tap puts the video in the head-up display or the instrument cluster (parked only, one at a time, off by default). Cluster screen in the settings: the centre map area, the whole cluster, or the left or right gauge's area (the rest of the cluster stays visible). Both need the separate Cluster renderer tool from the Store. Needs mgu-uplink internet

config.comment: Spelunkr: lineupUrl and channel (the first channel shown). streamUrl: one http(s) MP4 with H.264 video, played at the start instead of the home screen (testing). relay: the public phone page for Add source (https, holds no secrets); mailbox: the ntfy server the phone and the car meet on (messages are AES-256-GCM sealed). <data>/tv.json with lineupUrl / channel / streamUrl overrides these on the car.

_retiredSettings: settings 0.4.1 had and 0.4.2 dropped: a saved value is deleted on start (kit/runtime/mgu.js). Pictures is always Auto, Colours always M Tricolour, the Renderer always the GPU one; the HUD test and the Full cluster / Side panels tests are gone (Cluster screen plays the video there instead); Play in HUD is the HUD button on the picture (its on / off kept by the app, not a setting).
